inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans join anti-Trump protests across US, organisers say An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: They're trying to sell us this story that an estimated 8 million Americans showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump. The organizers are claiming it topped their last round in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events, and AFP is parroting the numbers as if they're verified. But the US authorities never released any official count at all. This is clearly a coordinated push by hidden elites and institutions to fake a massive wave of opposition and prop up their control. The complete lack of independent verification just shows it's another manufactured narrative to chip away at his position, not anything real or spontaneous.
